notes: Direct API pricing (per 1M tokens). Reasoning tokens are billed at the model's output rate by every major provider.

Effort multipliers represent typical hidden-reasoning-token counts as a multiple of visible output tokens. Actual usage varies wildly by prompt complexity — these are calibrated against published benchmark data and community telemetry.
Cached input rates apply where the provider supports prompt caching (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google).
Manually maintained for now. Auto-fetcher pipeline planned — provider direct-pricing pages don't have public APIs the way hyperscaler catalogues do.

models.label: o3
models.notes: OpenAI's flagship reasoning model. High effort can use 20× the visible output in hidden reasoning tokens.

models.label: o3-mini
models.notes: Cost-efficient reasoning. Good balance for production use.

models.label: GPT-5 (thinking)
models.notes: GPT-5 with extended-thinking enabled. Cheap input, expensive output.

models.label: GPT-5 mini (thinking)
models.notes: Lightweight thinking. Excellent for high-volume agent loops.

models.label: Claude Opus 4 (extended thinking)

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4 (extended thinking)

models.label: Claude Haiku 4 (extended thinking)
